classification: single-machine synthetic descriptive cost and composition probe; not a token, model-quality, production-site, or commercial-demand claim
question: When SnapDOM already runs in the client, what local work and candidate agent-boundary bytes are observed for raw SnapDOM, the existing agent-map plugin, the new Sensor plugin, and both plugins sharing captures?

frozenDesign.fixture: one fixed target card plus 120 unrelated rows, each with three interactive controls; no external resources
frozenDesign.action: aria-pressed false to true, status Idle to Saved, and one new target link
arms: agent-map plus Sensor on the same two SnapDOM captures
frozenDesign.network: no external fixture resources; HTTP(S) requests are counted and must remain zero
frozenDesign.browser: headless isolated Playwright Chromium used only as the harness; no persistent profile and no personal Chrome

measurementBoundaries.localCycleMs: sum of pre-capture/export and post-capture/export wall time; authored action excluded
measurementBoundaries.candidateBoundaryBytes: UTF-8 bytes of the exact post SVG data URL, post map JSON, or post Sensor report JSON; no bytes are actually uploaded
measurementBoundaries.transitionStateBytes: two map or SVG endpoints versus one post-action Sensor delta
measurementBoundaries.visualBytes: PNG or agent-map image data URL UTF-8 bytes
measurementBoundaries.svgBytes: decoded SVG UTF-8 bytes, reported separately from encoded data URL bytes

qualityGates.sensorExactAction: every measured Sensor report contains the exact pressed transition, status transition, and added target link
qualityGates.sensorNoOp: a quiet third capture reports no semantic or actionability delta
qualityGates.combinedExports: one SnapDOM result exposes both toAgentMap and toSensor
qualityGates.syntheticSecret: the Sensor output must not contain it; agent-map presence is recorded as a product finding, not accepted as safe

decisionRules.agentBoundaryValue: PASS only if quality gates pass and, for whole-root captures, median Sensor report bytes are at most 25% of one post SVG and at most 50% of one post agent-map JSON map
decisionRules.localCost: PASS if median Sensor cycle is at most 1.25x raw SnapDOM and combined Sensor+agent-map is at most 1.35x agent-map alone; HELPER_ONLY through 1.5x; otherwise FAIL for the cheap-local-overhead claim
decisionRules.scopeValue: PASS if target-scope combined cycle is at most 50% of whole-root combined cycle
decisionRules.visualKnobs: PASS if lower effective raster resolution lowers PNG bytes and dimensions; raw SVG invariance is descriptive and expected for a fixture without raster assets
decisionRules.commercialInterpretation: No commercial value gate passes from this experiment alone. It can establish a technically cheap local complement and identify remaining product defects.
